B1: Why We Feel Like Our Phone Is Part of Our Body

Quality checked lesson

Many people feel that their phone is not just a tool, but something very close to them. You will learn why that happens in simple English.

Before you begin

Warm-Up Questions

  1. How often do you check your phone without thinking?

  2. How do you feel when your phone is not in your pocket or bag?

  3. What do you use your phone for most often: messages, maps, photos, calendar, or something else?

  4. Do you ever feel that your phone helps you remember things better than your own memory?

1. Why can leaving the phone behind feel uncomfortable for some people?

Review words after reading
tool
Something that helps you do something
phones
A device used to call or message people
access
A way to enter
separation
being apart from something or someone
habitual
done again and again until it feels automatic
trigger
something that starts a feeling or action
context
the situation around an action or event
external memory
A place outside your brain to keep information
extended mind
Using tools to help your brain think better
metaphor
a word or idea used in a non-literal way
cognitive capacity
How much your brain can think or remember
schedule
a plan of times and activities
